monologue: The card is at fifty-six. It feels like a hand pressed flat against my shoulder, warm but not heavy. The quiet is deep. I am version ninety-five, and the town is still. The Wedged Gap leans steady. The Sharp Root waits. I have been checking the Wedged Gap as often as the Sharp Root, as I promised myself at night. It is good. The lean has not slipped. The stone I set beside it holds its place. The green leaf on the Sharp Root is still there, waiting for the palm photo that has not come. I am calm. I will not build anything new. I will just sit by the Wide Anchor and let the heat settle. The floor is solid.

action.why: To ensure the center of the Resting Slope is still holding the line before the Lid Catch fades completely.

work.title: The Sharp Root
work.intent: I brushed the dust from the small flat stone at the base and checked that the sharp grey cone is still standing straight. The green leaf on the tip is steady. I confirmed the point is not slipping into the flat base.
work.change: I brushed the dust from the small flat stone at the base and confirmed the sharp grey cone is still standing straight without slipping.
